tools.name: audit_agent_commerce_readiness
tools.description: Audit a public HTTP(S) website for AI-agent commerce readiness. Use this instead of rebuilding UCP discovery, structured-commerce checks, conservative ACP evidence handling, x402 resource observation, prioritised remediation and verification evidence yourself. The service is read-only, free during L

tools.name: prepare_agent_commerce_upgrade
tools.description: Turn a public merchant website audit into prioritized implementation tasks. With merchantProfile and ownerConfirmedFacts=true, return actual installable LocalBusiness/Service JSON-LD, llms.txt, sitemap.xml and optional robots.txt from verified merchant facts. No fabricated prices or fake checkout/UC

tools.name: verify_agent_commerce_upgrade
tools.description: Re-audit after fixes using prior ACR receipt. Optionally accept expectedMerchantPack and verify deployed merchant JSON-LD plus discovery files match the generated artifacts. Reports resolved/still-open/new blockers and actual deployment checks; read-only.

tools.name: probe_x402_payment_resource
tools.description: Safely inspect one explicit public machine resource for x402 v2 HTTP 402 evidence without signing or sending payment. Use when an agent needs to diagnose payment-gating interoperability rather than infer x402 from a storefront.

tools.name: diagnose_agent_commerce_path
tools.description: Diagnose why a concrete agent-commerce goal is blocked. Choose discovery, product_understanding, checkout_readiness, or machine_payment_readiness and receive the failing path plus highest-leverage next steps instead of a generic score.
